Dear [Recipient],  

As a skip-level leader at a large academic institution, I’ve had the privilege of observing Emily Carter’s contributions to Strategic Innovations Group. While not directly overseeing her work, I’ve engaged with her through cross-functional collaborations and stakeholder dialogues, which have provided insight into her impact as a Product Manager.  

Emily’s ability to align diverse teams around shared goals stands out. For instance, she spearheaded the integration of a new client analytics tool, coordinating with engineering, data science, and client success teams to ensure seamless adoption. Her approach balanced technical precision with user-centric insights, resulting in a 25% increase in client satisfaction within three months. This effort underscored her knack for fostering collaboration without micromanaging—a rare strength in fast-paced consulting environments.  

Her stakeholder management skills are equally notable. When navigating conflicting priorities during a high-stakes project, Emily prioritized transparency, regularly updating executives and clients on progress while maintaining strategic flexibility. This earned her consistent praise for her calm, solution-oriented mindset.  

While not a data analyst, Emily’s product decisions are consistently informed by measurable outcomes. She once restructured a feature roadmap based on early user feedback, which led to a 15% improvement in product adoption. Her work ethic is marked by reliability and intellectual curiosity, making her a trusted partner in complex initiatives.  

I wholeheartedly recommend Emily for any opportunity requiring strategic thinking, teamwork, and a commitment to excellence.  

Sincerely,  
[Your Name]  
[Your Title]  
[Institution Name]
